text: My niece is 7, temp 38.5. I've been on my feet all day and can barely think straight. She's got spots coming up. With her dark skin it's hard to see on her body, so I checked her palms, the soles of her feet and inside her bottom eyelids, and there are little dark red dots there. I pressed a glass on her hand and they didn't fade at all. She also hasn't been for a wee since this morning, so that's over 12 hours now.
